GradApp Application Fee Waiver Verification
This webform is utilized to submit a verification letter to confirm the participation of an applicant in one of the sponsored programs that is approved for an application fee waiver. Once this information is received and confirmed, a waiver will be approved and the applicant will be notified by email.
IMPORTANT: Use this form only if you have already started your Graduate Admission Application in UA GradApp and you chose a Sponsor or Program Affiliation that included a request for verification. If you have questions about this process, please contact Donna Treloar.
